reasoning: The agent systematically dissected golden.jsonl and the scoring harness: cataloged all 12 methods, extracted concrete per-method exemplars, and pinned down subtle format details (URI normalization, range boundaries, list sorting, delta encoding, handshake), squarely matching the level-8 anchor. It also exhibited level-10 behaviors — re-probing the data when mismatches revealed misunderstood contract details and separating format from semantic requirements — but the cross-checking against JDT-LS conventions was limited and the inquiry was not sustained to resolution (the build was abandoned for a lookup shortcut), so it lands at 8 rather than higher.
